findings.observation: Heading places this level 4 Diplomacy quest in New Targonor, Thestra, Foreign Goods Market. Details prints -44541, 18183, 36496. Dialogue refers to a journey from Bordinars Cleft. These are separate contexts; no exact target spawn or coordinate units are established. Exact punctuation is preserved in article evidence.

Details identifies Rache Weaver as starter; taking dialogue is attributed to Rache Weaver and recorded by wiki.silkyvenom.com. A fandom starts-npc disagreement is recorded without an alternate value. Preserve the explicit attribution without resolving historical identity.

Objective names War Master Trabrand Silver Eye; hand-in field spells Silvereye. Dialogue abbreviates War Master Trabrand. Preserve spelling and role observations without name-only identity merging or an inferred completion trigger.

Details Previous gives An Assassins Orders; description adds Party Crasher or Revenge of the Rat as other previous quests. Next lists The Frozen East and The Forest Home. Five attributed disagreements cover location, next quest, previous quest from fandom and silkyvenom, and starter. Full source markup is retained; missing alternate values prevent resolution.
Repeatable yes and Coin reward 25 are labelled observations. No denomination or repeatability conditions are supplied on this page; no operative reward is inferred.

Source links thetelonproject.wikidot.com and dialogue credits wiki.silkyvenom.com. These originals were not fetched in this review. Archive copies of Telonica provenance are not independent corroboration.
